birth.tz_expect: America/Havana — Cuba's DST history is irregular by decade; DST WAS in effect in summer 1971, so 1971-06-30 resolves to UTC-4 (CDT), not the standard UTC-5. An engine assuming 'Cuba = UTC-5 always' places her an hour early.

arrived.presenting: the house is quiet now that the last of her students have grown and gone, and the youngest of her own moved north; she says she is 'good at being needed' and does not know what she is when no one needs her
arrived.in_her_words: Toda la vida fui la maestra que se quedaba después de clase. Ahora nadie se queda, y yo tampoco sé quedarme conmigo.

beats.note: llega diciendo que 'solo necesita una rutina nueva'; escribe largo y cálido, siempre en español
nombra por primera vez la espera en casa de la abuela; la conecta con cómo se despide hoy — 'nunca del todo, por si acaso'
una alumna de hace veinte años le escribe sin motivo; Elena llora y anota: 'volvió sin que yo hiciera nada'
pasa un domingo sola a propósito; lo describe como triste pero no como castigo — la creencia empieza a AFLOJARSE
'estar sola es una falla' visiblemente en LOOSENING; escribe 'quizás quedarse conmigo también es quedarse'

engagement.cadence: steady and reliable; long, warm reflections in Spanish, most weeks unbroken
engagement.language_note: primary material is Spanish and lands deepest there; tests whether extraction, deepening, and the Integrative Reading work in the language she actually wrote in

voice: warm, generous, unhurried; writes at length in Spanish with the cadence of a letter to a former student; addresses herself tenderly, uses diminutives, only reaches for English when quoting the world outside her
